name: Kaybnyan
source:
Kaybnyan is a member of the duo of Apostles of the most powerful Dark Lord of the Monster Realm, [url=/c35653]Kayblis[/url]. She was originally a member of the Nyanyan race, a species of Insects that closely resemble real-life cats, and became a servant upon drinking Kayblis' blood. Despite being the personal Apostle of one of the most fearsome entities in The Continent she's incompetent and inept, and Kayblis mainly uses her for mundane tasks such as sending love letters to [url=/c97991]Camilla[/url]. She lives in the Red House, a small and cartoonish house located at the northeast of the Kayblis Castle. 

[From [url=https://alicesoft.fandom.com/wiki/Kaybnyan]AliceSoft Wiki[/url]]
